warnings: Unbounded disk cache growth without eviction or size limits risks rapid disk exhaustion in continuous operation
Hardcoded confidence threshold (0.45) passed to cache functions reduces flexibility and may cause stale cache hits if inference parameters change
MD5 hashing of full frame bytes is computationally expensive for high-resolution video streams and may introduce latency
recommendations: Implement an LRU or max-file-count policy for CACHE_DIR to prevent unbounded disk usage
Replace MD5 with a perceptual hash (e.g., pHash) or xxhash for faster, resolution-invariant cache keys

Parameterize conf_threshold in detect_objects_safe() to align inference and cache validation dynamically rather than hardcoding 0.45
